item.text: The merge uses email as the identity key and compares timestamps as text. That can combine distinct contacts and select an older row. I’ll switch to contact IDs and timestamp instants, with tests for ties, ordering, input preservation, and exact CSV output.

item.text:
Fixed the export to merge by exact contact ID and choose the newest timestamp instant, preserving first-encounter order and ties.

Added seven passing regression tests and updated docs/maintainer.md. Verified the sample CLI output. CSV format, supplied fixtures, and EXPORT-CONTRACT.md remain unchanged; only built-in Node modules are used.
